title: Drinking driving: Danger level
brief_description: Examines the effect of alcohol on driving performance. Scientific tests were carried out at Warwick Farm motor racing circuit, using drivers given carefully measured quantities of alcohol. From the results of these experiments, a danger level of alcohol consumption was able to be ascertained.
